[[Monk Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for monks by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Monk Gilded Vestments|Gilded Vestments]]
*[[Monk Adorned Handwraps|Adorned Handwraps]]
*[[Monk Aureate Pants|Aureate Pants]]
*[[Monk Ocher Sandals|Ocher Sandals]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 350{{cloth}}, 35{{damask}} and 40{{plat}}
